convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator 'ColorFisher_m11' which is a custom indicator not available as a built-in MT5 indicator. The EA depends on this custom indicator's buffer values for trading signals, requiring the custom indicator logic to be replicated or sourced separately.

derived_values.used_by: entry_rules long and short signal detection, signal_reversal_close

other_exits: Opposite signal from ColorFisher_m11 indicator closes existing position before opening new one in reverse direction

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Negative Lots input = fixed lot size (absolute value); Positive Lots input = fraction of free margin (Lots percent of free margin)

custom_logic_notes: The EA uses the ColorFisher_m11 custom indicator (Fisher transform variant with period 11). Signal logic: when indicator color changes from bearish to bullish (buffer crossover), close short and open long; when color changes from bullish to bearish, close long and open short. The Lots parameter has dual behavior: negative values are treated as fixed lot sizes, positive values as percentage of free margin. SL/TP values are adjusted for 5-digit brokers by multiplying by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001.
python_conversion_notes: The ColorFisher_m11 custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python. Fisher transform logic: median price over N periods, value normalization to -1/+1 range, then apply Fisher transform formula: y = 0.5 * ln((1+x)/(1-x)). The color/trend direction is derived from comparing consecutive Fisher values. Signal is generated on new bar when trend direction changes. Lot sizing dual logic: if Lots<0 use abs(Lots) as fixed; if Lots>0 calculate as Lots% of FreeMargin / (ContractSize * Ask). SL/TP pip values need 10x multiplication for 5-digit brokers.
